message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) for the given facts.

Facts: The defendant, Xu (许某甲), carried goods (aloe vera gel, milk powder, milkshakes) from Hong Kong to Shenzhen via Luohu port, did not declare to customs, was caught. Tax evasion amount 877.98 RMB. Also earlier on July 2, 2013, he carried 2 phones, not declared, caught, customs imposed administrative penalty (confiscation). On Feb 19, 2014, he carried 7 cans of milk powder, not declared, caught, administrative penalty. The prosecution says he evaded customs supervision, had two administrative penalties within a year, then smuggled again, violating criminal law article (one) and should be charged with "走私普通货物罪" (smuggling ordinary goods). The list includes "走私普通货物、物品". Indeed there is a label: "走私普通货物、物品". Also there is "走私国家禁止进出口的货物、物品". But here it's ordinary goods, not prohibited. So the charge is "走私普通货物、物品". Also maybe "逃税"? The tax evasion is 877.98 RMB, but the criminal charge is smuggling. The list includes "逃税". However the case is about smuggling, not tax evasion. The prosecution wants smuggling.
